title: 3 AI Stocks I'm Buying Before Earnings Season

findings.summary: Walks through three semiconductor and infrastructure names ahead of Q3 earnings, leaning on data-center capex guidance and gross-margin trends. Spends most of the runtime on NVDA's supply commitments and argues AMD is the better risk-reward at current multiples.

tickers.thesis: Argues data-center backlog is already contracted through next year, so a guidance miss is unlikely even if the multiple compresses.
Sees better risk-reward than NVDA because expectations are lower and the MI accelerator line is gaining named customers.
Thinks foundry losses keep compounding and the turnaround timeline keeps slipping.

macro_points: Expects the Fed to hold rates through year end

title: THIS STOCK WILL 10X BY FRIDAY (ACT NOW)

findings.summary: A short, urgency-heavy video promoting a small-cap biotech, followed by a pitch for the host's paid Discord. Offers no financial detail about the company and does not discuss downside.

tickers.thesis: Mentions it as confirmation that the whole AI sector is going higher, without specific reasoning.
Claims an imminent announcement will revalue the company, without naming the catalyst or citing a filing.

red_flags: Promises a 10x return in a specific, very short timeframe
No disclosure of whether the host holds the position
Video functions largely as an ad for a paid Discord
No discussion of downside or risk at any point

title: Weekly Market Recap: Rates, Earnings, and the Dollar

findings.summary: Macro-focused recap covering rate expectations and dollar strength. Touches on AMD only briefly as an example of sector rotation rather than as a recommendation.

tickers.thesis: Uses it to illustrate money rotating within semis rather than leaving the sector, and takes no directional view.

macro_points: Expects one more hold before any cut is discussed
Dollar strength is pressuring multinational earnings
